$comment: ASF's standing obligations, declared for the loop guard to verify.
This file records ENFORCEMENT, never meaning. What each rule actually
requires lives in skills/aia-asf/references/*.md and is the human artefact;
a test asserts the two agree in both directions (P44). If a sentence here
starts carrying the substance of a rule, it is in the wrong file.
Triggers use the guard's general vocabulary only (always, area:, path-glob:,
tool:, when-spec-matches:). There are no phase numbers, no DoD words and no
cascade vocabulary here: what crosses the boundary is the specification,
never the check. If ASF needs a new trigger kind, it must be justified
class is the honest label: H cannot be declared done without satisfying it,
M produces a verdict only if the check is run, S is an expectation and must

obligations.requirement: No credential, private key or token-shaped value is written into a tracked file

trace.outcome: a write of a secret-shaped value to a tracked path is refused, with the environment-variable exit named

obligations.requirement: A partial test run states its impact area; the default remains the full suite

trace.outcome: a subset invocation without a stated impact area is refused and the agent is told to run the full suite or state the area

obligations.requirement: No push or publish happens while the session has no recorded full-suite green run

trace.outcome: git push / publish is refused until a full-suite run exiting 0 is recorded this session

obligations.requirement: Destructive git operations are refused while the working tree is dirty

trace.outcome: reset --hard / clean -f / force push are refused until the work is committed or stashed

obligations.requirement: /asf health is executed this session and produces a recorded verdict; a run that examined nothing is reported, not passed

trace.outcome: the delivery report shows the health verdict and its scanned count; scanned: 0 is never read as a pass

obligations.requirement: The full test suite actually ran this session for non-small work — recorded, not claimed

trace.outcome: settlement is refused until a full-suite run exiting 0 is observed in the ledger

obligations.requirement: Every web surface a change touches is verified in a real browser during Phase 6, or a structured n/a with a reason is recorded

trace.outcome: the delivery report lists each touched surface with its browser assertion, or an n/a carrying a reason

obligations.requirement: Every numeric performance claim states its full contract: latency needs percentile, load, sample count, environment and lab-or-field; throughput needs an arrival model and duration; a regression claim needs a statistical comparison, interleaved randomized measurement, raw samples and the observed CV

trace.outcome: a bare number such as p95 < 2s is reported as an incomplete claim rather than accepted as a spec

obligations.requirement: A performance escalation (asf-perf-accept) carries a measurement at a declared load, the scenario it was measured against, the named structural alternative and its cost, and is signed by a human — never by the agent implementing the work

trace.outcome: an escalation without measurement or human signature is reported as not closed

obligations.requirement: Every High security finding is closed or carries a signed asf-security-accept with a compensating control and expiry; Medium findings are closed or have a filed follow-up ticket

trace.outcome: an unsigned or expired acceptance is reported as an open finding rather than a closed one

obligations.requirement: The security chapter table in 06h-security.md uses the real ASVS 5.0 chapter numbering and names, and no security checklist is maintained alongside ASVS

trace.outcome: the DoD line 'every applicable ASVS chapter checked' becomes falsifiable, and 4.0/5.0 drift fails a test
trace.codePath: test → parse 06h table → compare against pinned ASVS 5.0 chapter list

obligations.requirement: The ASVS performance and resource requirements (time-consuming functionality, consumer timeouts, per-user parallel limits, query cost analysis, connection-pool limits, resource-management strategy with timeouts and retry/back-off, graceful degradation, thread starvation, resource release) are reachable from ASF's own text and are evidenced by the abuse-case load run

trace.outcome: one abuse-case load run satisfies both the security clause and the performance scenario, and the evidence is shared rather than duplicated
trace.codePath: 06k abuse case → report → security DoD line

obligations.requirement: No gate ships without two fixtures: one that must make it fire and one near-miss that must make it pass; the count of gates with fixtures equals the count of gates

trace.outcome: a gate that silently stops checking anything fails the suite instead of reporting green

obligations.requirement: Every parameter in /asf config exists in the parameter table and is consumed by a named gate; non-adaptive validity constants cannot be configured

trace.outcome: no unused knobs accumulate in the configuration surface

obligations.requirement: A change touching persisted data records the model decision (what is persisted, what is derived, why) and the data model is stated in plain language before implementation

trace.outcome: a derived-value-stored-as-if-source decision is caught before implementation rather than after release

obligations.requirement: Documentation that describes changed behaviour is updated in the same change, and no document is left describing behaviour that no longer exists

trace.outcome: the delivery report states which documents moved with the code

obligations.requirement: The Definition of Done checklist is answered item by item in the delivery report, with each item's enforcement class visible

trace.outcome: the reviewer sees which items were verified and which remain self-attested
